H2.description: High resolution frames were assembled from ~97 framelets and split into three subframes H1-H3.

H3.description: High resolution frames were assembled from ~97 framelets and split into three subframes H1-H3.

Res.description: The frame-level resolution product listed in the LOIRP image taxonomy.
